svg.aria-label: The same fitting rule on three samples Panel: Start with different samples Panel: Fit one line to each sample Panel: Summarize at each input Two training points per fit At $x=0$ | At $x=4$ Fit A: 1 | 5 Fit B: 3 | 5 Fit C: 2 | 8 Each line fits both points in its own sample. All three use the same straight-line model. Individual predictions on shared axes Input x: 0 to 4 Prediction: 0 to 9 Fit A (line): (0, 1); (4, 5) Fit B (line): (0, 3); (4, 5) Fit C (line): (0, 2); (4, 8) Mean and observed range Input x: 0 to 4 Prediction: 0 to 9 Mean and observed range (line): (0, 2) [1, 3]; (1, 3) [2, 3.5]; (4, 6) [5, 8] At $x=4$, the three predictions are 5, 5 and 8. Their mean is 6. The shaded band runs from the smallest to the largest prediction. Prediction spread across training samples illustrates model variance. These three fits give an illustrative observed range.
